summary: Reddit and other FPL forums are not a source for the live news tag. A post time is not enough: the body can be edited, a comment needs its own time, and an anonymous line is not a team sheet. Reading old threads to fill Gameweeks 1–5 is out. A forum may only point at a club statement or a named reporter, and that piece’s own time is what the date gate uses. Gemini kept forums out.
